sections.content: @layer establishes explicit cascade order for stylesheets — base, components, utilities — so file load order stops mattering. Layers beat specificity: later layers win regardless of selector strength.
This kills !important wars and makes large teams sane: declare layer order once in :root or the first import, then slot rules into their layer.
Key points: unlayered styles beat layered ones (wrap everything), @layer can be inline per-rule, and it composes with media/supports queries.
